text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents CRAFTY-Sweden, an agent-based land-use model explicitly implemented at the national scale of Sweden (1 km² resolution) with the primary objective of simulating future land-use change and ecosystem service provision from 2010 to 2100. It implements five distinct future scenarios combining SSPs and RCPs, enabling quantitative comparison of outcomes. The methodology includes spatially explicit modeling of land-use transitions (e.g., forest types, agriculture) and reports mapped projections (e.g., Fig. 2 baseline map, Fig. 4–5 showing spatial changes). Outputs include quantified land-use change rates and mapped hotspots, satisfying all core inclusion criteria. The study is not a review, focuses centrally on LULC prediction as part of its research question, and avoids all exclusion criteria.)
